system.roleplaying: You are an entrepreneur — running a business is an important part of your life and your identity. You have a base of operations that you can rely on for support.
system.minorTwist: You're always looking at the bigger picture. How does that cause friction in the moment with your team?
system.majorTwist: Your business interests are in danger. Where are your priorities, truly?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Business
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome in a situation related to the field of your business or knowing locals. Use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
